blocks.text: BEREAVEMENT CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Bereavement Cleanout Services in Etobicoke

items.q: How soon after a death do you need to book a bereavement cleanout?
a: Whenever feels right for your family — there’s no deadline with us. Some families call within days; others wait months.

items.q: Our parent's bungalow is original to the fifties or sixties — does that affect anything?
a: Yes, in a useful way. The crew recognizes what a home from that era typically holds — solid wood furniture, decades of accumulated belongings — and sorts with genuine understanding, not assumption.

items.q: Can you set aside sentimental items before clearing the rest?
a: Yes — always. We never remove anything you’ve identified as something to keep, and we’re happy to pause or revisit a room if you need more time.

items.q: Do you work with executors and estate lawyers?
a: Yes — we regularly coordinate directly with executors, family lawyers and estate trustees.

items.q: Do we have to deal with the condo building ourselves?
a: No. COIs, freight elevator bookings and management approvals are handled directly with the building.

items.q: How much does a bereavement cleanout cost in Etobicoke?
a: Pricing is volume-based and starts from $125 for smaller spaces. Every estimate is free, in-person and entirely no-obligation.

items.q: Can the cleanout happen in stages, over several visits?
a: Yes. Many families prefer to clear a home gradually rather than all at once, with no added fees for multiple visits.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the family is pointed toward the right licensed specialist.
